_doc: Book 2 figure spec — the single source of truth for every Book 2 figure. Edit this file, then run `npm run prebuild` (or `node scripts/sync-second-book.mjs`) in website/ to copy it and the PNGs into the site. `website/src/data/figuresTwo.test.tsx` checks every entry: the PNG exists, the section heading exists in the chapter, each claim id is filed under the figure's chapter in evidence-2.json, and each source is an anchor label of one of those claims. Each .excalidraw file in chNN/ is the source; render it with `npx @excalidraw-skill-pack/render`, then resize to 2000px and quantise (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-23-second-book-parity-design.md, Drawing).
